title: Rich content gallery
description: Diagrams and prose inside a form: figures on nodes and options (`x-content`, `x-options`), plus a Mermaid source editor with a live preview (`x-control: "mermaid"`). Use `schemaui web --schema examples/rich-content.schema.json --config examples/rich-content-defaults.json`. Everything the engine renders for this schema arrives in `SessionResponse.rich` — inspect `GET /api/v1/session` to see the sanitised assets.

figures.title: Figures on fields
figures.description: `x-content` attaches a figure or prose block to the node itself. The AST carries the source; the engine renders and sanitises it at session build time. Switch the theme in the header — diagram variants for both are already in the payload, so switching costs nothing.

deploy_flow.title: Mermaid figure
deploy_flow.description: A rendered diagram, shown above the (unused) control. The value is a placeholder; the figure is the point.

status_legend.title: SVG figure
status_legend.description: Raw SVG, rebuilt through an element/attribute whitelist — scripts, event handlers and foreignObject would have been dropped at load.

runbook.title: Markdown block
runbook.description: Markdown converts to sanitised HTML server-side; tables and strikethrough are on, and so are links and inline code.

x-content.source:
### Runbook excerpt

1. **Drain** the node from the load balancer.
2. Apply the config and wait for the health probe (see `ops/probes.md`).

| Step | Owner | SLA |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Drain | on-call | 5 min |
| Verify | on-call | ~deliberately unscheduled* |

Escalate if two probes fail ~~twice in a row~~ in the same window. Details live in [the wiki](https://example.com/runbook).

choices.title: Choices with figures
choices.description: `x-options` adds per-option label, description and figure, aligned with the enum by index. Hover a thumbnail to enlarge it (viewport-aware), click it for the fullscreen viewer with copy/download.

topology.title: Deployment topology
topology.description: A radio group whose options are diagrams. The enum still validates exactly as before — the figures are presentation.

x-options.label: Mesh
x-options.description: Every node talks to every other node. Lowest latency, highest link count.

content.source:
flowchart LR
  a --- b
  b --- c
  c --- a

x-options.label: Star
x-options.description: All traffic through one hub. Simple, and the hub is a single point of failure.

content.source:
flowchart LR
  hub(hub) --- a
  hub --- b
  hub --- c

provider.title: Storage provider
provider.description: A plain dropdown; labels are overridden and each option carries its own small diagram inside the popup.

reference_arch.title: Reference architecture
reference_arch.description: A dropdown whose options are diagrams: pick the architecture by looking at it.

compact_pick.title: Compact picker
compact_pick.description: Segmented has no room for figures, so `x-options` here carries labels only — declaring content on a segmented control is a load error.

more_shapes.title: More shapes a figure can take
more_shapes.description: Figures are not tied to one node kind or one diagram type: the header above is a section-level `x-content`, the Mermaid family covers sequence and pie diagrams too, a nullable enum can carry figures on its real options, and an array can host a figure of its own.

x-content.source:
flowchart TD
  more[This section] --> shows[shows four]
  shows --> shapes[kinds of figure]

cost_split.title: Pie chart

failover_mode.title: Nullable choice with figures
failover_mode.description: An enum that also allows `null`: figures sit on the two real options, and the null option keeps its plain label.

diagram_editing.title: Editing a diagram
diagram_editing.description: The value of a `mermaid` control is the source itself — the field stays a plain string on the wire. With a renderer available the right pane previews as you type; without one this is an ordinary text area.

pipeline.title: Pipeline (Mermaid source)
pipeline.description: Edit the source; the preview re-renders after you stop typing. A parse error shows the renderer's message next to the source instead of the last good diagram.
pipeline.default:
flowchart TD
  clone(clone) --> build
  build --> test[pytest]
  test --> sign
  sign --> publish((crates.io))
